records.query: MATCH (x:CommerceNode) RETURN properties(x) AS p,id(x) AS native
MATCH (s:CommerceNode)-[x:CommerceEdge]->(t:CommerceNode) RETURN properties(x) AS p,id(x) AS native,id(s) AS source,id(t) AS target
MATCH (s:CommerceNode)-[e:CommerceEdge]->(t:CommerceNode) RETURN s.original_key AS source,e.original_key AS edge,t.original_key AS target

MATCH (a:CommerceNode)-[e:CommerceEdge]->(b:CommerceNode) MATCH (b)-[f:CommerceEdge]->(c:CommerceNode) RETURN a.original_key AS source,e.original_key AS edge1,b.original_key AS middle,f.original_key AS edge2,c.original_key AS target
MATCH (s:CommerceNode)-[e:CommerceEdge]->(t:CommerceNode) RETURN s.original_key AS source,e.original_type AS relationship,count(e) AS occurrences,count(DISTINCT t) AS destinations
MATCH (n:CommerceNode) RETURN properties(n) AS p ORDER BY n.original_key LIMIT 1
MATCH (n:CommerceNode) WHERE n.type_id = '11' RETURN properties(n) AS p ORDER BY n.original_key LIMIT 1

scope: Actual named immutable local export Cypher; no scalar promotion, UC, continued native source retention, atomic activation, or Gremlin qualification.
